title: AI SEO Engineer
description:
**This role is for one of our clients**  

  

Seniority level: Associate level

Experience: 2\+ yrs



Location: Pune, Maharashtra, India



Job Type: Full\-time



We are looking for an experienced and forward\-thinking **AI SEO Engineer – Search Everywhere Builder** to drive the next generation of enterprise SEO through a combination of **SEO expertise, engineering, AI, automation, and agentic technologies**.



The ideal candidate will be an SEO\-first professional who thinks like an engineer and can transform search requirements into scalable, automated, and production\-ready digital experiences. You will focus on improving discoverability and organic growth across traditional search, AI\-powered search, social platforms, marketplaces, video platforms, and other emerging search ecosystems.



**Requirements**
----------------


### **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**


* Lead enterprise SEO strategy across **content, keyword ecosystems, information architecture, search intent, topical authority, and organic growth**.
* Develop and execute **Search Everywhere** strategies across Google Search, AI search engines, LLMs, social search, marketplaces, video platforms, and internal search experiences.
* Partner with Technical SEO, Product, Engineering, Content, Analytics, and UX teams to embed SEO throughout the product and content lifecycle.
* Develop SEO and **GEO best practices, governance frameworks, and AI\-first operating models** for scalable execution.
* Build and deploy **AI agents, automation workflows, and pipelines** to improve SEO productivity and reduce repetitive manual execution.
* Leverage AI and automation to accelerate content production while maintaining quality, relevance, and governance standards.
* Develop scalable strategies across multiple business verticals, website templates, content types, and customer journeys.
* Strengthen internal linking, entity SEO, topical authority, programmatic SEO, and search intent optimisation.
* Continuously research emerging changes in search engines, LLMs, AI search, and generative search experiences.
* Prototype, test, measure, and productionise innovative SEO solutions and workflows.
* Use data and search performance insights to identify opportunities for improved visibility, traffic, engagement, and business outcomes.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to translate SEO requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Establish repeatable systems and processes that enable SEO execution at enterprise scale.

### **WHAT MAKES YOU A GREAT FIT**


* **3–5 years of hands\-on Enterprise SEO experience**, ideally managing large\-scale websites and demonstrating measurable impact on organic growth and business outcomes.
* Strong expertise in **SEO, keyword strategy, information architecture, search intent mapping, topical authority, and internal linking**.
* Strong understanding of **Entity SEO, Programmatic SEO, and Search Everywhere optimisation**.
* Experience developing and scaling SEO strategies across multiple business verticals, templates, content ecosystems, and customer journeys.
* Deep understanding of **Google Search, AI Search, LLMs, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)**.
* Hands\-on experience with enterprise SEO platforms such as **SEMrush, Ahrefs, and Moz**.
* Experience using **AI/LLM platforms, agentic frameworks, and automation tools** to improve SEO workflows.
* Comfortable working with programming or engineering technologies to build and scale SEO solutions.
* Strong understanding of technical SEO principles and the ability to collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret search data, identify opportunities, and measure SEO impact.
* Strong experimentation mindset with the ability to rapidly prototype, test, learn, and productionise new solutions.
* Ability to balance SEO quality, scalability, automation, and governance.
* Strong communication and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
* A strong interest in **AI\-native SEO, automation, agentic systems, and the evolving search ecosystem**.

Job Description:
**JOB SUMMARY:**


* Responsible for all activities and processes related to the creation, maintenance, governance, and continuous improvement of Product Data Management.
* Work with cross\-functional teams to ideate, create, and enforce business rules to manage product data, material masters, bill of materials, and change management processes.
* Lead process improvement and automation initiatives utilizing tools such as Winshuttle, Excel VBA, SAP, Windchill, and other relevant technologies to improve efficiency, accuracy, and data integrity.
* Extract, analyze, and interpret large volumes of data from SAP, Windchill, and other enterprise systems to support business decisions, audits, and process improvements.
* Create process documentation, provide technical guidance and training to peers and team members, and lead projects related to Product Data Management and Engineering Systems.
* Provide daily operational support to business units through SAP material master lifecycle maintenance while balancing strategic improvement initiatives and project responsibilities.

**1\. Data Engineering, Reporting \& Analytics**


**Expected End Results** Extract, analyze, interpret, and present large amounts of data to support business decisions, audits, and process improvements.

  

**Major Activities**


* Continuous support of PDM teams and customers to extract and analyze data from SAP tables, databases, Windchill, and other enterprise systems.
  

* Support cross\-functional groups with ad hoc data requests, reporting, and root cause analysis.
* Develop complex data extracts, dashboards, audit reports, and analytics to drive informed business decisions.
* Provide technical support, guidance, and training to requestors and team members.

**2\. Develop Automation Tools**


**Expected End Results** Develop workflows, automation tools, and technical solutions to improve efficiency, standardization, and data quality.


**Major Activities**


* Develop, maintain, and enhance Winshuttle scripts, Excel VBA tools, templates, and automation solutions.
* Partner with PDM teams and stakeholders to identify automation opportunities and eliminate manual work.
* Design, build, test, deploy, and support automation tools and process improvements.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and best practices to improve productivity and team effectiveness.
* Provide technical mentorship and support to team members utilizing automation tools.

**3\. Audits**


**Expected End Results** Analyse, develop, and enhance audits as a tool for data quality and governance.


**Major Activities**


* Understand complex business rules and develop audit extracts to influence and improve data integrity.
* Perform advanced data analysis to identify root causes and corrective actions.
* Leverage SAP tables, databases, and enterprise systems to execute large\-scale audits and support decision\-making.
* Recommend process improvements based on audit findings and trends.

**4\. Data Storage \& Handling**


**Expected End Results** Ensure secure, accurate, and efficient storage and management of data, reports, and technical documentation.

  

**Major Activities**


* Storage and maintenance of documents, reports, automation tools, and business data on global servers.
* Develop and maintain new processes, standards, and best practices for data management.
* Ensure timely backup and recovery of stored data.
* Create, manage, and optimize databases and repositories to support business needs.
* Maintain technical documentation and knowledge management resources.

**5\. Project Management**


**Expected End Results** Lead projects and continuous improvement initiatives while effectively managing operational responsibilities.


**Major Activities**


* Represent Product Data Management by leading and supporting local, regional, and global projects.
* Drive automation, standardization, and process improvement initiatives.
* Make informed technical and operational decisions on behalf of the Product Data Management team.
* Effectively document, communicate, and present project outcomes and recommendations.
* Balance project execution with day\-to\-day operational workload and stakeholder commitments.
* Mentor peers and support knowledge transfer activities across the team.
  

**Relevant Experience**


**Engineer:** 4\-7 years


**Senior Engineer (recommended):**


* **4\-7 years of relevant experience in Product Data Management, SAP, PLM/PDM systems, Engineering Systems, Data Analytics, or Process Automation.**

**Personal Characteristics \& Technical Expertise**


* Strong written and verbal communication skills with effective presentation and stakeholder management abilities.
* High proficiency in Microsoft Excel, SAP, Windchill, and other Product Data Management (PDM) or Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) applications.
* Strong customer focus and excellent customer service skills.
* Advanced analytical and problem\-solving capabilities with experience working with large datasets.
* Hands\-on experience developing automation tools using **Excel VBA, macros, Winshuttle, SAP data extraction tools, and related technologies.**
* Ability to extract, analyse, and interpret large volumes of data from SAP databases and enterprise applications.
* Strong understanding of Material Master, BOM, Engineering Change Management, and Product Lifecycle processes.
* Creative thinker with a continuous improvement mindset and a passion for automation and digital transformation.
* Ability to balance technical development, project work, and day\-to\-day operational support.
* Experience mentoring peers and providing technical guidance to team members.
* Flexibility to support a wide variety of work related to Product Data \& Lifecycle Management.

  

**Preferred Skills**


* Winshuttle Studio
* Advanced Excel VBA / Macro Development
* SAP Data Extraction and Reporting
* Windchill PLM Administration/User Experience
* Data Analysis and Visualization
* SQL (Optional)
* Power BI (Optional)
  

**RELATIONSHIPS AND CONTACTS:**


Supervisory relationships: \- Reports to: Manager – Engineering Systems \& PDM

  

**Organization relationships:** \- Regular contact with Kohler Global PDM Teams, IT, Project Management and Engineering community. \- Frequent contact with Marketing, SCM \& Service Teams. \- Regular contact with peers, superiors, and junior associates. \- Occasional interactions with other business units and departments such as QA, Plant, Process Engg, Product Engg, Purchasing, Warehouse teams, Supply Chain, Customer Service.

  

**External business relationships:** \- Participating in technical forums/webinars to explore the techniques and programs related to PDM systems, processes, and tools. \- Third party service providers, partners, and suppliers/ vendors.


Mandatory Skills:
SAP MM , Data Analysis, Data Management, BOM, Windchill, Winshuttle, VBA, Data Quality

description:
**Marketing Executive**
=======================

#### **Full Time**


#### **PUNE**

  

Job Summary  

We are looking for a dynamic, energetic, and target\-driven Marketing Executive to promote our overseas education services and strengthen our presence across schools, colleges, coaching centres, and other educational institutions. This is a field\-intensive role, with approximately 70% of the time spent travelling to educational institutions, conducting promotional activities, organising seminars, and building relationships with key stakeholders.  

The ideal candidate should possess excellent communication and networking skills, be comfortable with extensive travel, and have a passion for interacting with students and educational professionals. **Key Responsibilities**  

* Institutional Outreach \& Relationship Management
* Visit schools, colleges, universities, coaching institutes, and educational organisations to promote the company's overseas education services.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with principals, counsellors, placement officers, teachers, and institutional decision\-makers.
* Identify and develop new institutional partnerships to expand the company's network.

  

* Marketing \& Student Engagement

* Organise and coordinate seminars, career guidance sessions, education fairs, workshops, and promotional events.
* Deliver presentations on overseas education opportunities, study destinations, universities, admission processes, scholarships, and visa pathways.
* Represent the company at educational events and exhibitions.
* Distribute marketing materials and ensure effective brand visibility at partner institutions.

  

* Lead Generation

* Generate quality student leads through institutional visits and promotional activities.
* Collect and maintain accurate student data and enquiry information.
* Ensure timely follow\-up of leads by coordinating with the counselling and admissions teams.
* Meet monthly lead generation and institutional visit targets.

  

* Business Development

* Identify opportunities to increase brand awareness and student engagement.
* Develop new marketing initiatives to expand the company's reach.
* Gather market intelligence, competitor information, and student preferences.

  

* Reporting \& Administration

* Maintain records of daily field visits, institutional meetings, seminars conducted, and leads generated.
* Submit regular activity reports and market feedback to the reporting manager.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth execution of marketing campaigns and events.

  

* Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Education, Communications, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in field marketing, educational marketing, business development, admissions, or sales.
* Experience in the overseas education industry is preferred but not mandatory.

  

* Required Skills

* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Strong networking and relationship\-building abilities.
* Confidence in speaking to large student groups and institutional representatives.
* Strong organisational and event coordination skills.
* Lead generation and business development skills.
* Good negotiation and persuasion abilities.
* Basic knowledge of overseas education, study abroad programmes, or international admissions is an advantage.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and CRM software is preferred.

  

* Key Competencies

* Self\-motivated and target\-oriented.
* Professional and confident personality.
* Excellent interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Strong problem\-solving and planning skills.
* Willingness to travel extensively.

  

* Working Conditions

  

\* Approximately \*\*70% field work\*\* involving regular travel to schools, colleges, coaching centres, and educational institutions.* 30% office\-based work for planning, reporting, coordination, and follow\-up.
* Local travel on a daily basis, with occasional outstation travel for education fairs, seminars, and institutional partnerships.
* Flexible working hours during events and admission seasons.

  

* Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Number of institutional visits completed.
* Number of new institutional partnerships established.
* Number of seminars, workshops, and promotional events organised.
* Student enquiries and qualified leads generated.
* Conversion of leads into counselling appointments and admissions.
* Achievement of monthly and quarterly marketing targets.
* Quality of institutional relationships and repeat engagement.
* Timely submission of activity reports and market feedback.

  

* Preferred Candidate Profile

* Passionate about education and student engagement.
* Comfortable travelling extensively and working in the field.
* Energetic, proactive, and results\-driven.
* Possesses a valid driving licence and own vehicle (preferred).
* Fluent in English and the local language.
